      "sentence": "This man with diabetes and a prior myocardial infarction has new chest pain, reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, and stenoses of both the LAD and left circumflex arteries.",
      "grounding": "question",
      "question_quote": "Coronary arteriography shows a reduced ejection fraction, a 65% stenosis of the left anterior descending artery, and a 75% stenosis of the left circumflex artery.",
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "CABG is considered for multivessel coronary disease with ischemic left ventricular dysfunction, particularly when angina is ongoing.",
      "grounding": "passages",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": ["InternalMed_Harrison:012702"]
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Although the stem does not specify whether the LAD stenosis is proximal, the combination of diabetes, LAD-involving two-vessel disease, and reduced ejection fraction favors CABG over stenting in this case.",
      "grounding": "none",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Heparin may be used acutely if an acute coronary syndrome is suspected, and a long-acting nitrate can relieve angina, but neither revascularizes the affected myocardium.",
